name: Python Developer
tagline: Write professional Python and ship the APIs, tools and services teams hire for.
description: Everything a junior Python developer role asks for, in an order that builds on itself. Start with core Python and its idioms, go deep into decorators, generators, typing and asyncio, then learn the professional toolchain: virtual environments, packaging, ruff, mypy, pytest and CI. Build web APIs with FastAPI, Pydantic and SQLAlchemy, add concurrency, Docker and deployment, and finish ready for the coding screen, the behavioral rounds and your first team.
outcome: You can write idiomatic, typed and tested Python; build, test and deploy a FastAPI service backed by a SQL database; package and publish a library with CI; solve easy and medium coding problems in Python while explaining their complexity; and show a portfolio of Python projects that proves it.

stages.title: Core Python
stages.summary: Syntax, types, control flow, functions, the built-in data structures, files, exceptions, modules, classes and regular expressions.
stages.milestone: Write a 200-line program with functions, classes, file handling and exceptions, and explain every line of it.

stages.title: Python in depth
stages.summary: Decorators, context managers, generators, itertools and functools, typing, error-handling patterns, profiling and asyncio, plus clean code, design patterns, object-oriented design and debugging.
stages.milestone: Write a decorator, a context manager and a typed generator pipeline from scratch, and refactor messy code without changing its behavior.

stages.title: The professional toolchain
stages.summary: The shell, git on your own and in a team, virtual environments, dependencies and packaging, ruff, mypy, pytest in depth, logging, configuration and CI.
stages.milestone: Publish a package with a src layout, mypy strict, ruff and pytest passing in CI on three Python versions.

stages.title: Databases, HTTP and web APIs
stages.summary: SQL and database design, how HTTP and REST work, calling APIs, building them with FastAPI (and reading Flask), SQLAlchemy, authentication and web security.
stages.milestone: Build a FastAPI service with a SQL database, authentication, validation and an integration test suite.

stages.title: Concurrency, containers and deployment
stages.summary: Threads, processes and asyncio, Docker, CI/CD and the cloud, and the system design basics behind a service that stays up.
stages.milestone: Containerize your API, deploy it through a CI/CD pipeline, and explain when to reach for threads, processes or asyncio.

stages.title: The coding screen, in Python
stages.summary: Big-O, the core data structures and the interview patterns most Python screens use, practiced with timed challenges.
stages.milestone: Solve easy and medium problems in Python within 30 minutes while explaining your approach and its complexity.

stages.title: Get hired and do the job well
stages.summary: Your resume and portfolio, behavioral interviews, and how engineering teams work day to day once you are in.
stages.milestone: A one-page resume with three Python projects, a bank of interview stories, and a plan for your first 90 days.
